ValidationRule.description: Blocks moving Stage to Contract Requested until Customer, Primary Contact, Management Company, and Info Verified are filled.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Contract Requested"), OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Stage__c) ), OR( NOT(Info_Verified__c), ISBLANK(Customer__c), ISBLANK(Management_Company__c), ISBLANK(Customer__r.Primary_Contact__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before Contract Requested, fill Customer, Primary Contact, Management Company, and check Info Verified.
